note: Family campground a mile and a half west of Keystone in Battle Creek Canyon on Old Hill City Road, about 3 mi from Mount Rushmore, under ponderosa pine among granite hills. Full-hookup pull-throughs on the west side by the pool; the east-side sites are along Battle Creek. Water-electric-satellite and full-hookup sites suit a 23-ft rig; the plain water-electric sites are 14-ft pads for pop-ups and vans. Also electric tent sites, pop-up rentals and cabins. --Claude
